bibl.title: Text and Landscape. The complementarity of the Papiro Vaticano Graeco11 R (PMarm) to landscape-archaeological results from the arid Marmarica (NW-Egypt/NE-Libya).
bibl.seg: Anna-Katharina Rieger, Text and Landscape. The complementarity of the Papiro Vaticano Graeco11 R (PMarm) to landscape-archaeological results from the arid Marmarica (NW-Egypt/NE-Libya).
bibl.note: The papyrus (recto): general allocation, philological characteristics and chronological frame: Chronological framework of the registers of the document; - Philological particularities: a non-Egyptian papyrus. - The papyrus, the Γεωγραφικὴ ὑφήγησις of Klaudios Ptolemaios and physical-geographical characteristics of the wider region: an attempt at geographical allocation: Concordances with topographical names from other sources; - Locating the districts of the PMarm in the landscape. - PMarm as a source for administrative organization in a marginal region based on topographical features: Administrative entities; - Topographical features in words and landscapes; - Arable units and scarce water resources; - The relation of the properties to each other and their inner organization; - People, or what to infer from names. - The agriculture of the Marmarica: PMarm compared to agricultural products and crops from archaeo-botanical and -zoological finds. - Text and landscape.
